messages:
deploybot: Starting hotfix deploy -> prod-us-west
tag: v1.7.2-hotpatch
commit: 3f9b2a7f
initiator: alex
strategy: canary 10% -> 50% -> 100%
change window: 02:00-04:00 UTC
preflight: kicking off smoke tests + infra checks

alex: on it. i'll watch metrics for 20m. @jordan pls open the latency/cpu dashboards and keep eyes on 95p

ci-bot: preflight results:
- smoke tests: PASS
- dry-run migrations: OK
- artifact checksum: OK
- infra quotas: OK

sam: note — feature flag `enable-new-tokenizer` is currently ON in prod. recommend toggling off before promote to avoid user-facing diffs

alex: toggled `enable-new-tokenizer` -> OFF. logging step: `ff-toggle v1.7.2-hotpatch off by alex`

deploybot: Executing canary rollout (10%). Command:
```
deploy --tag v1.7.2-hotpatch --env prod-us-west --strategy canary --canary-percent 10 --commit 3f9b2a7f
```

deploybot: Canary deployed to 10% at 02:12 UTC — instances updated: 6/60. health checks passing so far :white_check_mark:

jordan: seeing 95p latency +30ms compared to baseline, but error rate still low. keeping watch.

maya: monitor rule: if 5xx > 0.5% for 5m OR error spikes in >2 nodes -> rollback. i'm on pager.

deploybot: Canary running. rolling log tail:
```
[02:13:08] INFO app: started request handler on node-3
[02:13:09] WARN proxy: retrying upstream for /v1/generate
[02:14:55] ERROR model: unhandled exception in tokenizer -> HTTP 502 x8
```

maya: alert — 5xx spike in prod-us-west-east, rate ~1.3% over 3m. Affected pods: node-3, node-5. Correlating with tokenizer lib changes. :rotating_light:

alex: copy. aborting canary promote. initiating rollback to v1.7.1. tagging investigation.

sam: confirmed `enable-new-tokenizer` was off, so this looks like a runtime regression unrelated to flag. good call to rollback.

deploybot: Rollback initiated at 02:17 UTC -> target tag v1.7.1. Command:
```
rollback --to-tag v1.7.1 --env prod-us-west --force
```

deploybot: Rollback in progress — replacing 6 canary instances, verifying healthchecks.

jordan: metrics stabilizing as nodes revert, latency returning to baseline.

ci-bot: post-rollback health checks: all smoke tests PASS, 5xx rate back <0.1% after 3m window

maya: rollback complete at 02:20 UTC. marking deploy aborted. opening incident thread in #incidents with logs and sample traces.

alex: thanks everyone. next steps: create a short repro with tokenizer inputs, run local stress tests, and hold patch until root cause identified. i'll owner the follow-up.

deploybot: Deploy aborted; canary stopped. Notifying oncall and creating rollout audit entry. Audit id: AUDIT-2051201123-3f9b2a7f

alex: filing release note snippet: 'v1.7.2-hotpatch: attempted prod canary, rolled back due to 5xx in tokenizer; reverted to v1.7.1. Investigation ongoing.'

sam: adding label `hotpatch-investigation` to the commit and linking CI artifacts
deploybot: Closing this thread. Further updates posted to #incidents/2051201123. :lock:
